correctness.rationale: PASS: In characteristic two D_f=f(t) d/dt is a well-defined derivation subject to c0=0 only in odd truncations, and D_f² is also a derivation with D_f²(t)=f f_prime. For v=ord_t(f), the square-zero condition is exactly vanishing of odd coefficients c_j for j<=n-v; multiplication of the even-power span by t^v times a unit shows rank min(m,ceil((n-v)/2)). Counting the valuation alternatives produces punctured affine-plane×A^{2r-2} at ranks 1..floor(m/2), and G_m×A^{m-1} above, identically for lengths 2m and 2m+1. Exhaustive independent F2 direct matrix rank enumeration through n=12 matched all predicted rank histograms. These charts are reduced loci, and no nonreduced scheme claim is made.
